mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document_asset_relation (relation_id, extraction_id, document_id, asset_id, subject_entity_id, predicate, object_entity_id, evidence_text, evidence_bbox, attributes, confidence) VALUES (CAST(#{relationId} AS uuid), CAST(#{extractionId} AS uuid), CAST(#{documentId} AS uuid), CAST(#{assetId} AS uuid), CAST(#{subjectEntityId} AS uuid), #{predicate}, CAST(#{objectEntityId} AS uuid), #{evidenceText}, #{evidenceBbox,typeHandler=com.kama.jchatmind.typehandler.PgDoubleArrayTypeHandler}, COALESCE(CAST(#{attributes} AS jsonb), NULL), #{confidence})
